e4709c8f8169.why: truefit.toml is the check registry itself: each fix (factorium#186-189) changed it only to register a [[model]] (worktrees, line), re-pin a model's commit, or add covers for new code; the promises those fixes keep live in models/*.tla and the code their covers name, not in this file
